plan_title: SSPLAN-654 Test Plan — Build weekly Financial Forecast dataset

results.test: Primary Build weekly Financial Forecast dataset render path
results.steps: Open target route with valid fixture/user context.
results.assertion: Expected primary content appears with correct title/value labels and no console/runtime error.
results.evidence: No live server was available in this run. To verify manually, open `/`, `/hfb/:id`, and `/hfb/:hfbId/pa/:paId` from frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36 and confirm the weekly chart, title, toggles, and CY/LY/forecast data render without runtime errors. Relevant source path: frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/SalesIndexChart.tsx:19-23,82-83,116-123,153-158.

results.test: Interaction path for Build weekly Financial Forecast dataset
results.assertion: State transition completes within 1 click/gesture and target view/data updates correctly.
results.evidence: No live server was available in this run. To verify manually, open the weekly chart routes from frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36 and confirm switching the metric to QTY shows forecast while non-QTY views hide it. Relevant source path: frontend/src/features/entity-detail/SalesIndexChart.tsx:19-23,82-83,116-123,153-158.

results.steps: Return empty dataset or no eligible rows.
results.assertion: Fallback/empty message is shown and layout remains stable (no broken placeholders).
results.evidence: The weekly chart handles empty input safely by rendering a placeholder instead of crashing when `allData.length === 0` (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/SalesIndexChart.tsx:19-23,82-83,116-123,153-158).

results.assertion: Error state is user-visible, recoverable on retry, and does not hard-crash route.
results.evidence: Weekly metric failures are caught in the HFB/PA pages so the route stays up (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173), but the chart has no explicit retry/error UI for this dataset path.

results.steps: Run representative fixture values through transform/mapping layer.
results.assertion: Scaled and raw fields retain expected precision (sales scaled where applicable, index untouched).
results.evidence: The forecast dataset is not fully mapped into the rendered chart: `metricsApi` types only include `weeklyForecastedQuantityCy`, and `transformWeeklyTrendRows` writes `forecast: null` for every row (frontend/src/services/metricsApi.ts:12-14,172-215,244-257,289-297).
results.failure_reason: Financial forecast dataset is not mapped into weekly chart model

results.steps: Feed out-of-order and duplicate-key fixture records.
results.assertion: Output order and uniqueness follow deterministic rule (documented sort/dedupe behavior).
results.evidence: Week ordering is deterministic because rows are sorted by parsed `sywNumber` (frontend/src/services/metricsApi.ts:12-14,172-215,244-257,289-297), but duplicate week identity is preserved rather than deduped.

results.steps: Inspect generated request payload and query params for this feature path.
results.assertion: Metric/level/filters are populated exactly as expected for selected hierarchy context.
results.evidence: The source provides HFB/PA `WEEKLY_SALES_TREND` calls only (frontend/src/services/metricsApi.ts:12-14,172-215,244-257,289-297); there is no country-level request body builder or `fetchSalesByWeek` API matching the plan.
results.failure_reason: Weekly dataset request contract missing country implementation

results.steps: Compare required FE keys against backend response schema fixture.
results.assertion: Missing or renamed required keys fail with explicit diff and actionable message.
results.evidence: No explicit schema diffing exists, and the FE contract only models quantity forecast fields, not the broader weekly forecast schema the plan expects (frontend/src/services/metricsApi.ts:12-14,172-215,244-257,289-297).
results.failure_reason: No weekly forecast schema drift guard
